bundle.shortDescription: Lightweight YouTube desktop client with ad-blocking and SponsorBlock
bundle.longDescription: Youtube is a native desktop YouTube client built with Tauri. It features Brave's adblock-rust engine for network ad-blocking, cosmetic ad filtering, SponsorBlock integration for automatic sponsor skipping, multi-profile support, and a native download manager.
